verdict.rationale: Published power, connector and cooling specs are a fair question for any GPU, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never states a TDP/TGP figure, connector requirements or cooling guidance for the B200 itself. The docs only describe system-level DGX power supplies (six PSUs in 5+1 redundancy) and say per-GPU maximum power is reported at runtime by nvidia-smi. That is an adjacent tool, not a published spec a gamer could plan a build around.

support.subject: As a gamer, I can spec a build around published board power — TDP/TGP, connector requirements, and cooling guidance for this exact card
